raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the liar/truth-teller logic. The Orchestrator incorrectly rejected the “all vampires” case by claiming that their shared statement being false would contradict their lying nature, when in fact it is consistent (vampires lie by asserting a false statement). They then allowed vampires to repeat a true statement alongside a human, leading to 99 vampires. Since everyone said “At least one of us is a human,” the only consistent scenario is that this statement is false, implying zero humans—i.e., all 100 residents are vampires.
